notes: Original research article (Chem. Eng. J. 379 (2020) 122367); record.json is_retracted is false and the text contains no retraction notice; no statement that the H2 uptake values were published before. H2 uptake measured at 77 K and 298 K, 0-20 bar, on a Sievert-type apparatus with ~100 mg samples (Section 2.5); BET area measured by N2 at 77 K on the same activated carbon cloth samples (Section 2.4, Table 2). Carbon sorbent: carbonized and activated viscose rayon cloth, N-doped, EDS C 80-84 at.% (Table 1).
